result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [ZPHWindowResult]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | greenwood description: >- Test results for a single time window within a windowed proportional-hazards test. twitter-card: title: >- [ZPHWindowResult]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | greenwood description: >- Test results for a single time window within a windowed proportional-hazards test. title: >- [ZPHWindowResult]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: >- Test results for a single time window within a windowed proportional-hazards test. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Test results for a single time window within a windowed proportional-hazards test. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/greenwood/blob/main/greenwood/_cox.py#L46-L90){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-class} ```pythonsignature ZPHWindowResult( interval, n_events, per_term, global_test, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} When `cox_zph()` is called with `breaks=`, it partitions events into time windows and runs a separate proportional-hazards test in each window. Each `ZPHWindowResult` holds the test statistics for one window. ::: ## Attributes {.doc-attributes} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [interval]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [tuple[float, float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The half-open time interval `(lower, upper]` that this window covers. [n_events]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of events (Schoenfeld residuals) in this window. [per_term]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[str, dict[str, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping each covariate name to `{chisq, df, p_value}` dict. [global_test]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[str, float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary with `{chisq, df, p_value}` for the joint test across all terms. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Fit a Cox model on the `lung` dataset and run a windowed proportional-hazards test. Each element of the `windows` list is a `ZPHWindowResult`: ::: {#39d4b291 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import greenwood as gw lung = gw.load_dataset("lung", backend="polars") cox = gw.CoxPH().fit("Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex", data=lung) zph = cox.cox_zph(breaks=[365]) zph.windows[0] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ZPHWindowResult(interval=(0.0, 365), n_events=121, per_term={'age': {'chisq': 1.84727953653936, 'df': 1, 'p_value': 0.17410013215647083}, 'sex': {'chisq': 1.5635082246947267, 'df': 1, 'p_value': 0.21115228715555173}}, global_test={'chisq': 3.221968471495387, 'df': 2, 'p_value': 0.1996909743256601}) ``` ::: ::: Inspect the per-term results for the first window: ::: {#92ebd1c5 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} zph.windows[0].per_term ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` {'age': {'chisq': 1.84727953653936, 'df': 1, 'p_value': 0.17410013215647083}, 'sex': {'chisq': 1.5635082246947267, 'df': 1, 'p_value': 0.21115228715555173}} ``` ::: :::
